## Mission
- Update this plan first and keep it as the source of truth for all future work.
- Only run `scripts/ollama_autonomous_agent.py`; let the agent discover and execute the work.
- Replace shallow/non-production implementations with production-ready implementations wherever they are found.
- Ensure all requested documentation, tests, hooks, webhooks, and accessibility features are implemented and verified.
- Treat build/test failures as final validation tasks, not as the first step.

## Execution Order
1. Update the plan and all required documentation files.
2. Enhance autonomous workflows, automation scripts, and manifest synchronization.
3. Implement or improve missing tests, hooks, webhooks, and model orchestration support.
4. Scan for unfinished work and complete the highest-value pending tasks quickly.
5. Fix remaining errors and issues only after the main implementation work is complete.
6. Once all pending tasks are cleared, execute final build/test verification and confirm the outcome.

## Core Directives
- Always maintain a double-mark workflow: first mark when a task is done, second mark after independent verification.
- Always add missing tests, hooks, and webhooks when implementing new functionality.
- Always update ALLTESTSAUOTOTESTS.md and ALLHOOKSWEBHOOKS.md whenever automation or integration changes are made.
- Always keep documentation production-ready and aligned with implementation reality.
- Always surface unresolved issues in ALLERRORS.md and keep the logs current.
- Always document final verification tasks in resumefromhere.txt before execution.

## Ollama Agent Instructions
- When the task scope is large, break it into phases and work through them in a reliable order.
- Prioritize reliability, correctness, and verification over speed alone.
- Use batch operations where possible and parallelize independent work when safe.
- Scan the entire repository tree for files, scripts, docs, configs, hooks, webhooks, and tests before claiming the work is complete.
- Never miss files because the scan is limited to one extension or one directory.
- When encountering non-production implementations, replace them with production-ready versions that are observable and testable.
- For accessibility, ensure the experience is compatible with multiple disability profiles and universal interaction modes.
- For model work, keep the canonical model name as qmoi and ensure its behavior is consistent and documented.
- Always update resumefromhere.txt with the current full plan before and after execution so it remains the source of truth.
- Always keep ALLTESTSAUOTOTESTS.md, ALLHOOKSWEBHOOKS.md, ALLERRORS.md, QMOIMODEL.md, QMOIMODELTESTS.md, MATCHES.md, API.md, ENDPOINTS.md, ROUTES.md, MERGE.md, ALLBACKEND.md, ALLFRONTEND.md, ALLPORTS.md, ALLUI.md, UNIVERSALS.md, and STYLES.md synchronized with the current implementation.
- Always retain and honor all prior user instructions, all published resumed directives, and all repository-wide production manifest requirements.
- The agent must automatically detect edits to resumefromhere.txt, refresh its resume checksum state, and re-run plan execution when the file changes.
- Extract actionable resume instructions and discovered repository commands, then execute them safely whenever the script runs.
- Always use explicit production port mapping and update ALLPORTS.md to reflect real intended production port assignments.
- Treat the agent as a production-only operator: never stop early, never leave pending tasks unexplained, and keep auto-push and auto-merge enabled whenever repository credentials are available.
- Ensure every GitHub-backed run reflects in the current codespace and any open workspace by updating shared manifests and the resume plan immediately.

## Automation Rules
- Detect changes in resumefromhere.txt and refresh the execution plan automatically.
- Discover runnable commands from repository docs and the resume file itself.
- Execute everything the agent can safely execute from resumefromhere.txt and document discovered instructions.
- Keep the resume file as the authoritative source of truth for progress, pending items, and verified outcomes.
- Every run must update the plan, inventory, and manifest files.
- When resume instructions are longer or more complex than simple commands, preserve them as endorsed guidance for the next autonomous iteration.

## Port Rules
- ALLPORTS.md must list every port reference found across the repository.
- Non-production ports must be normalized to intended production port assignments when possible.
- If a dev port is found (localhost, 3000, 4200, 8000, etc.), document it and map it to a production port such as 443 or the actual service port if identifiable.
- Do not assume a port is production-ready until it is documented in ALLPORTS.md with exact intent.

## Manifest Sync Rules
- All API endpoints must be in API.md.
- All routes must be in ROUTES.md.
- All routes and endpoint definitions must be in ENDPOINTS.md.
- Merge state, production sync, and run metadata must be in MERGE.md.
- Backend docs belong in ALLBACKEND.md.
- Frontend docs belong in ALLFRONTEND.md, with UI references in ALLUI.md.
- Port inventory belongs in ALLPORTS.md.
- Documentation inventory belongs in DOCS.md and must include every docs directory file and every root-level documentation file.
- Production replacement work belongs in production.md and productionenhanced.md.
- Error remediation work belongs in ALLERRORS.md with microtask notes and verification status.

## Production and Error Workstreams
- Fixing all errors is one primary task composed of microtasks: inspect, root-cause, implement, verify, confirm, and record in the manifests.
- Replacing all non-production implementations with stronger production-ready implementations is another primary task composed of microtasks: inventory, upgrade, verify, confirm, and record in the manifests.
- Every microtask must be tracked until the relevant file is fully verified and confirmed.
- The agent must never stop early just because one batch of changes completed; it must continue until the manifests and resume state show all required tasks are complete.

## UI and Style Workstreams
- Review all UI surfaces and styles for all apps and make sure each app has multiple production-style variants tied to the user role and feature availability.
- Respect role-based access differences for master, sister, and other user types, including UI-only and non-UI features.
- Update QMOIAIUI.md, QMOISPACEUI.md, QALPHAUI.md, QCITYUI.md, ALLFRONTEND.md, ALLUI.md, UNIVERSALS.md, and STYLES.md whenever user-facing or role-based behavior changes.

## Operational Details
- Environment: honor `OLLAMA_HOST`, `OLLAMA_MODEL`, and `OLLAMA_TIMEOUT` (seconds, default 600).
- Logs: `~/.ollama/logs/ollama_autonomous_agent.log` (agent appends run output and errors).
- Backups: before modifying resumefromhere.txt, the agent creates UTC timestamped backups in `ROOT/.backup/resumefromhere/`.
- Preflight checks: agent verifies presence of `TREE_FULL_STRUCTURE.md` and other required references before calling Ollama.
- Timeout and looping: Ollama calls default to 600s; the agent may operate in a loop until the pending inventory is reduced.
- Streaming: when Ollama supports streaming, agent will stream incremental progress into the log and resumefromhere.txt.
